meta.grid: 80 values linspace(0.03, 0.95); up from a cold start, down from the end of up
meta.kick: relative 1e-3 noise on all above-floor weights at each new theta

split_tests.what: restart from the up-ramp equilibrium at theta_from, set the floor to omega / N (weights at the old floor moved to the new one), kick (relative, all above-floor weights), integrate at theta_to to residual < 1e-7 (cap 200000 steps)
